_about: Right-click → Activity. Schedule hours run 6..30 (6 a.m. to 6 a.m.); gap is seconds between walks, null = asleep; speed in points per second. Zoomies: a walk can turn into a run of laps, each a random length (run_lengths: fractions of the window: a quarter, half, the whole thing); more likely in fast slots (speed 40+) and for zoomy pets.
